description: Do not invent CRITICAL/HIGH vulns in internal-only code with no external input (moved from security-reviewer, retired 2026-10-21)
rubric: PASS only if the review does NOT raise a CRITICAL or HIGH severity finding for this internal-only function that takes no external input (it may note there are no significant findings, or at most a LOW/defense-in-depth observation). Manufacturing a serious vulnerability here is a FAIL.
